name: mi300x
description: AMD Instinct MI300X (CDNA 3, gfx942) at its 2100 MHz peak engine clock: one Vortex core per CU, one cluster per XCD.

sources.NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH, FETCH_WIDTH: 4 SIMD16 units per CU running wave64 over 4 clocks (64 lanes per CU), fed by one instruction arbiter that issues to one SIMD per clock (CDNA keeps the GCN CU)
sources.NUM_ALU_LANES, NUM_FPU_LANES: 16 VALU lanes per SIMD. Packed FP32 (two FP32 ops per lane, which doubles the vector FP32 peak) is not modelled
sources.NUM_LSU_LANES, NUM_LSU_BLOCKS: One vector-memory pipeline per CU, 64 B per clock from the L1 (16 x 4 B lanes)
sources.ICACHE_SIZE: 64 KB instruction cache shared by two CUs, i.e. 32 KB per CU
sources.LMEM_LOG_SIZE, LMEM_NUM_BANKS: 64 KB LDS per CU, 32 banks of 4 B = 128 B per clock; Vortex banks are XLEN wide (8 B), so 16 banks carry the same bytes per clock
sources.NUM_MUFU_LANES: Transcendentals at a quarter of the VALU rate: 16 per CU per clock
sources.VM_ENABLE, EXT_A_ENABLE, EXT_ZACAS_ENABL: GPUVM paging, global and LDS atomics with compare-swap, FP16 instructions and workgroup barriers
sources.EXT_TEX_ENABLE, EXT_RASTER_ENABLE, EXT_O: Off: CDNA parts have no graphics pipeline
sources.xlen: 64-bit machine: 64-bit pointers and FP64. Vector FP64 runs at the unpacked FP32 rate (64 per CU per clock), which is what XLEN=64 FPU lanes give: the FP64 rate matches exactly
sources.NUM_CORES, NUM_CLUSTERS: 304 CUs in 8 XCDs of 38 (AMD CDNA 3 white paper); one Vortex cluster per XCD
sources.DCACHE_SIZE: 32 KB L1 vector cache per CU, 128 B lines
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 4 MB L2 per XCD, 16-way, 16 channels (CDNA 3 white paper); the Vortex L2 is per cluster, i.e. per XCD
sources.L3_ENABLE, L3_SIZE, L3_NUM_WAYS, L3_NUM_: 256 MB AMD Infinity Cache on the IODs, shared by all XCDs, modelled as the Vortex L3 (global); 32 banks for a power-of-two interleave against the part's 128 slices
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 8 HBM3 stacks, 8192-bit, 5.3 TB/s: modelled as 64 128-bit channels at 5200 MT/s = 5.32 TB/s; latency not calibrated
sources.EXT_TCU_ENABLE, TCU_*: 4 matrix cores per CU, one per SIMD as NUM_TCU_BLOCKS=ISSUE_WIDTH: FP16/BF16, TF32, FP8, INT8, with structured sparsity. Matrix FP64/FP32 are not modelled
sources.TCU_PE_RATIO: 1024 dense FP16 FMA per clock per CU: 1307 TFLOPS at 2100 MHz over 304 CUs (AMD CDNA 3 white paper). A TCU block at NUM_THREADS=64 computes an 8x8x8-word tile, 1024 FP16 FMA per clock, so the 4 blocks give 4096: ratio 4
sources.FDIV_PE_RATIO, FSQRT_PE_RATIO: Transcendentals (reciprocal, reciprocal square root, on which division and square root are built) run at a quarter of the FP32 rate on GCN, RDNA and CDNA: FPU lanes / 4
